scope: H11 frontend independent source and author-evidence review

findingsClosed.finding: A captured cancel or retry callback could use the replacement request.
findingsClosed.originalEvidence: scan-owner-red.txt: two actual failures (extra cancel IPC and extra scan IPC)
findingsClosed.finalCode: Handlers capture visibleRequest and require exact current Request ownership; request UUID must also match the displayed scan.

findingsClosed.finding: An observation timeout was classified as a settled scan and lost its exact cancellation path.
findingsClosed.finalCode: responded marks the IPC observation ending; readPending leaves settled false. The UI keeps an exact cancel action and describes cancellation as requested with completion unconfirmed.

additionalReview: Cancellation delivery rejection resets cancelRequested only while the same live request remains unsettled; no automatic cancellation retry or scan restart is introduced.
A user-requested scan retry gets a new UUID and retires/cancels the previous request; OS completion is not inferred from cancellation acknowledgement.
Input remains editable during scanning. Errors remain distinct from an empty match list. Partial results, truncation, bounded matching and the system file picker remain visible paths.
File candidates remain names, not identity receipts: existing current file reads and dispatch-time attachment checks retain their authority.
Source inspection confirms textarea Tab can focus an enabled scan action; actual browser focus and scroll are outside this review.

authorChecksRead.classification: valid regressions for two findings, not independent rerun

authorChecksRead.additionalCase: explicit cancel retry after delivery rejection

boundaries: Source and controlled hook tests do not establish native OS cancellation, installed-app UI or real-Agent acceptance.
Backend bounded traversal and file-handle implementation are owned and verified separately.
No production, test, existing evidence or user data was modified by this review.
